§ Darius = "lord"

2) Darius, the son of Hystaspes, the founder of the Perso-Arian dynasty (521 BC)
3) Darius II or Darius III

1895.d: a primitive root of uncertain (perhaps foreign) derivation;
t:
1) (Qal) to divide
1a) be an astrologer (with obj-heavens)

1896.d: or (by permutation) ; probably of Persian origin;
1896.s: Hege or Hegai, a eunuch of Xerxes
t:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Est.2.3
§ Hegai or Hege = "eunuch"
one of the eunuchs of the court of Ahasuerus

1897.s: to murmur (in pleasure or anger); by implication, to ponder
1897.k: imagine, meditate, mourn, mutter, roar, [idiom] sore, speak, study, talk, utter.
t:
1) to moan, growl, utter, muse, mutter, meditate, devise, plot, speak
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to roar, growl, groan
1a2) to utter, speak
1a3) to meditate, devise, muse, imagine
1b) (Poal) to utter
1c) (Hiphil) to mutter

1899.s: a muttering (in sighing, thought, or as thunder)
t:
1) a rumbling, growling, moaning
1a) a rumbling, growling
1b) a moaning
1c) a sigh, moan, sighing
